title: Place an isolated structural footing at a point
task: Place an isolated structural foundation footing at a point using Autodesk.Revit.Creation.ItemFactoryBase.NewFamilyInstance with an OST_StructuralFoundation FamilySymbol, a level and StructuralType.Footing. Covers structural footing modelling.

pitfalls.symptom: A task search 'place an isolated structural footing at a point' does not surface the creation member; top hits are FamilyInstance.StructuralUsage/StructuralType properties.
pitfalls.cause: The creation member is Autodesk.Revit.Creation.ItemFactoryBase.NewFamilyInstance(XYZ, FamilySymbol, Level, StructuralType) (reached as doc.Create.NewFamilyInstance); its generic name/summary ranks poorly for structural intent (connector issue #341).
pitfalls.fix: Search naming NewFamilyInstance; use the XYZ/FamilySymbol/Level/StructuralType overload with StructuralType.Footing.

pitfalls.symptom: The placed foundation is a wall or slab foundation rather than an isolated footing.
pitfalls.cause: OST_StructuralFoundation covers isolated footings, wall foundations and foundation slabs; the first symbol collected may not be an isolated (point-placed) footing.
pitfalls.fix: Pick a point-placed isolated-footing FamilySymbol under OST_StructuralFoundation, activate it, and place with StructuralType.Footing.

miss.text: place an isolated structural foundation footing family instance at a point on a level
